label: Teltonika TRB141 (GPIO)
description: Rugged Cat 1 GPIO gateway: no Ethernet port, cellular plus digital/analog I/O.
notes: Vendor figures from the Teltonika wiki interface table: SIM slot, **4G LTE Cat 1** radio, **3 x digital inputs, 1 x analog input, 2 x relays**, UART on the PCB and **1 x virtual network interface via micro USB** - and **no Ethernet port at all**. That is the point of the TRB141: it is an I/O bridge for a machine, so there is nothing to plug a cable into. Recorded with its cellular interface only; a request that expects a copper port on this model is asking for a different device.
